name: Amazon Ancient Ruins
coordinateSystem: presentation x/z in LEGO stud pitches; exact instruction transforms may use local subassembly coordinates or LDD stud-normalized coordinates when manual-corroborated

transformGoal.completionRule: 420/420 regular inventory slots must have manual-page provenance plus an explicit instructionTransform carrying position and orientation

sourceNotes: V0.6.3 improves presentation fidelity without changing exact-count policy: the exact 30149 vehicle tub and 30147 grille now render as molded multi-surface parts instead of generic boxes, and the 33129 boat hull uses a recognizable open hull presentation.
The entire boat assembly receives one runtime presentation offset to the corrected river datum so hull and fittings remain rigidly aligned; inventory positions and exact transforms remain unchanged.
V0.6.2 preserves the 0.35-stud build-surface datum while pits and the river descend into the six-brick-deep molded baseplate envelope.

The gateway/bridge presentation remains centered on the existing exact gate-core origin: the corrected 16x4 bridge spans the river east-west and its gateway-side endpoint meets the gate-core footprint.
Vehicle pages 7-8 are the presentation rebuild source; remaining car-body proxy pieces stay explicitly non-exact until step-specific placement is resolved.
The unique Light Gray 30149 two-seat vehicle tub is exact from page 7 plus LDD ref 809, and the unique Light Gray 30147 round-top grille is exact from page 8 plus LDD ref 800.

The molded 30271px1 baseplate is one real inventory part. Its 32x48 footprint and six-brick depth are represented by a thin floor shell plus excluded terrain-mold helpers; those helpers consume zero inventory slots.
Rope bridge 2549 uses its catalog 16x4 footprint in the presentation scene.
Page 4 contributes the complete crocodile subassembly: unique Green 6026 body, 6027 upper jaw and 6028 tail with LDD refs 933, 932 and 934.

Page 22 contributes the Light Gray 30104 chain, Yellow 4032 pulley, Blue 3700 crank connector, unique Dark Gray 30156pb01 printed sloped facade, unique Blue 3009 brick, White 3937 / Yellow 3938 hinge pair and Black 3176 plate-with-hole.
Gateway placements tagged manual-page-28/manual-page-30 remain tied directly to instruction scans.
Raw LDD coordinate regions are discovery hints only; exact promotion still requires instruction provenance and conflict-free occurrence identity.
A community LDD 4.3.8 reconstruction by penguinz remains a geometry cross-check; its known raised-baseplate, Sun Disc and decoration substitutions remain non-authoritative.
All ledger-counted regular-part usage is validated against the BrickLink 172-lot / 420-part inventory snapshot in this repository.
